plane_model: all original vias projected, original other copper excluded; one new signal plane, continuous GND reference only required not implemented

cost_modes.avoid_other: 8 * max(0,1-distance/0.8mm) penalty around other independently routed centerline

search_policy: At most both route orders times four first-channel costs, no source hole moves or clearance reductions. First routes may be redesigned; second is fresh shortest route with first as copper obstacle. Stop at first exact same-plane success or eight scenarios. Explicit --scenario can replay one declared scenario. Not an unrestricted global optimization.
x2_expansion_gate: Only if both x1 channels pass exact checks on the same plane; x2 must have a separately stated bounded scenario set.
